findings.evidence: return [value for value in left if value in right]
findings.summary: Linear search in `right` list causes quadratic time complexity O(len(left) * len(right)).
findings.suggested_action: Convert `right` to a `set` before the list comprehension to achieve O(1) average lookup time and overall O(len(left) + len(right)) time complexity.

limitations: No runtime benchmarks or execution profiling data were provided.
